notes: Registry of authoritative or institutional named-vineyard/site bulk sources. A source record establishes identity/boundary evidence only. It does not by itself authorize a protected-origin wine, a grape, a vintage, or a site claim.

sources.authority: Bureau Interprofessionnel des Vins de Bourgogne
sources.notes: Bourgogne Maps reports 11,541 identified Climats/lieux-dits and 296,663 mapped parcels.
Official public registry/map covers more than 1,600 Einzellagen and registered Gewanne; Gewann list dated 2026-08-04.
Official Riedenkarte documents all 140 wine-growing Rieden with parcel-level delimitation.
Ried boundaries are being captured for the first time and are explicitly not yet available statewide.
